verdict.rationale: Retell documents an official CLI for managing agents, phone numbers and knowledge bases from the terminal, plus typed Node.js and Python SDKs with API key auth covering the voice and chat endpoints. Together these support scripted, headless management of Retell resources. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance or examples, documented non-interactive CLI authentication, a headless way to run automated agent tests (simulation tests are shown only via Conductor), and independent hands-on corroboration.
